SHANGHAI TIMES,

SEP 9 1938

Surcharge
On Power
Co. Bills

Now To Have Effect One
Month Later Than
Announced

As reported in yesterday's issue
of "The Shanghai Times," the sur-
charge on the bills of the Shanghai
Power Company, which was at first
made applicable to all bills render-
ed on or after August 1, is now to
be made applicable to all bills
rendered on or after September 1.
A full explanation of the matter
was contained in a communique
released by the Publicity Office of
the Shanghai Municipal Council
yesterday afternoon, this reading as
follows:
With reference to the notice
appearing in the "Municipal Gazette"
of July 29 last, it has now been re-
vealed that a misunderstanding
occurred on the part of Members
of Council with regard to the
application by the Shanghai Power
Company for authority to apply a
surcharge on its tariff. This ap-
plication proposed that the sur-
charge should apply to all bills
rendered on or after August 1, 1938,
in respect of consumption periods
ending on or after that date, but
Members of Council overlooked the
significance of this phraseology
and, when authorizing the sur-
charge, their understanding was
that it would apply to consumption
as from August 1. The surcharge
as approved by the Council was
made subject to monthly adjust-
ments in accordance with fluctua-
tions in exchange.
Company Exonerated
The position has been further
discussed between the Power Com-
pany and the Council and, in order
to overcome the difficulty created
by this misunderstanding, for which
the company is in no way respon-
sible, the Company, at the request
of the Council, has consented to
postpone the application of the
surcharge by one month, and this
will now therefore commence with
bills rendered on or after Septem-
ber 1, 1938, in respect of consump-
tion periods ending on or after that
date, for which bills the surcharge,
assessed on the basis referred to
above, will be 32.5 per cent. as al-
ready announced. It will be noted
that electricity consumed prior to
August 1 will not now be subject
to any surcharge. The Company
will refund or credit to all con-
sumers the surcharges paid in
respect of consumption periods
ending during the month of August,
1938.

（批：9/9 Like C%）

《字林西报》，

1938年9月9日

电力公司账单
附加费

生效日期现推迟至
公告日期一个月后

正如昨日《字林西报》所报道，上海电力公司（Shanghai Power Company）账单附加费原定适用于8月1日或之后出具的所有账单，现将改为适用于9月1日或之后出具的所有账单。上海公共租界工部局新闻处于昨日下午发布了一份公报，对此事作了充分解释，内容如下：

关于去年7月29日《市政公报》上刊登的通知，现已查明，工部局董事在理解上海电力公司申请批准对其费率征收附加费一事上存在误解。该申请提议，附加费应适用于1938年8月1日或之后出具的、且计费周期结束于该日或之后的所有账单；但董事们忽视了这一措辞的含义，在批准附加费时，他们的理解是附加费将适用于自8月1日起的用电量。经工部局批准的附加费须根据汇率波动按月进行调整。

公司免责

电力公司与工部局已就此事进一步进行了讨论。为了克服由这一误解造成的困难——公司对此完全不负责任——应工部局要求，公司同意将附加费的实施时间推迟一个月。因此，附加费现在将从1938年9月1日或之后出具的、且计费周期结束于该日或之后的账单开始征收。对于这些账单，按上述基准计算的附加费率为已公布的32.5%。值得注意的是，8月1日之前消耗的电力现在不再征收任何附加费。公司将向所有用户退还或抵扣在1938年8月期间结束的计费周期内已支付的附加费。

（批注：9/9 如 C%）

August 31, 1939.

MAINICHI :

RECONSIDERATION OF SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY URGED BY
JAPANESE AMALGAMATED ASSOCIATION OF STREET UNIONS

The Standing Committee of the Japanese
Amalgamated Association of Street Unions held a meeting
at the Headquarters of the Association at 4 p.m. August 30
to discuss the price of rice and the increase in the
electricity charges of the Shanghai Power Company.
Among those present were Mr. Hayashi,
Chairman of the Association, and more than 20 committeemen.
After a discussion lasting 3½ hours, the
meeting decided to watch developments in the rice situation
for the time being; as for the question of electricity
charges, the meeting held strong views, and elected ten
men, including Mr. Hayashi, to form an Opposition Committee
to handle the question, The following unanimous opinion
was reached:-
"At this time of extremely high cost of
living, it is a serious blunder on the part of the Shanghai
Power Company to increase electricity charges by 120%.
"We admit that higher prices have to be
paid for necessary materials, etc., but we cannot see
any reason for such a high increase.
"For the sake of the people's livelihood,
we shall oppose this unfair action of the Power Company
to the bitter end.
"We shall, if necessary, convene a
general meeting to consider the situation."

（左侧手写批注：D.P.S. / monograph / C 1/4）

1939年8月31日。

《每日新闻》：

日本街道工会联合会敦促重新审议上海电力公司问题

日本街道工会联合会（Japanese Amalgamated Association of Street Unions）常务委员会于8月30日下午4时在该会总部召开会议，讨论米价及上海电力公司电费上涨问题。出席会议的有该会理事长林先生（Mr. Hayashi，音译）及二十余名委员。经过长达三个半小时的讨论，会议决定暂时观望米价局势的发展；至于电费问题，会议持强烈反对意见，并选举包括林先生在内的十人组成反对委员会来处理此事。会议达成以下一致意见：

“在生活成本极高的当下，上海电力公司将电费提高120%是一个严重的错误。
“我们承认必要材料等的价格必须上涨，但我们看不出如此大幅上涨的任何理由。
“为了民众的生计，我们将坚决反对电力公司的这一不公行为。
“如有必要，我们将召开全体大会以审议局势。”

（左侧手写批注：D.P.S. / 专题报告 / C 1/4）
